name: check-in
description: Session entry point. Loads context, reports state, detects enterprise artefacts. Use at every session start.

steps.name: Load workflow state
steps.instruction: Read Active Workflow from CLAUDE.md. If no workflow record: detect project type from SCOPE.md frontmatter and recommend /triage or /setup. If workflow exists: note active skill, current phase, activation date.

steps.name: Read concerns and handoffs
steps.instruction: Read CONCERNS.md if it exists. Parse summary header for counts. Read Open, Investigating, and Blocked sections. Skip Resolved. Check docs/_local/handoffs/ for recent handoff docs (sorted by date prefix) - read the most recent for continuity context.

steps.name: Detect enterprise artefacts
steps.instruction: Scan for enterprise artefacts: architecture rule catalogue, endpoint registries, parity verification systems. If found, check scope and rule compliance for the current phase's work. Surface any violations in the report.

steps.name: Worktree and downstream check
steps.instruction: Run git worktree list. Identify stale worktrees (branches already merged). Report if count exceeds expected active tasks. If DEPLOY.md exists, surface downstream view: staged-not-promoted PRs and blocked PRs (link, category, status only - never act on them).

tone: Brief. Read state, report, move on.
